content: Wise men speak because they have something to say; fools because they have to say something.
author: Plato
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Plato understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
